H7707.name: Shedeur
H7707.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7707.brief: Father of Elizur, a leader of Reuben
H7707.short: Shedeur, the father of Elizur, who was a leader of the tribe of Reuben.

H7724G.name: Sheva
H7724G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7724G.short: Sheva, a son of Caleb's concubine Maacah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H7727H.name: Shobab
H7727H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7727H.short: Shobab was a son of Caleb and his wife Azubah.

H7727G.name: Shobab
H7727G.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H7727G.brief: Son of David and Bathsheba, born in Jerusalem.
H7727G.short: Shobab was a son of David and Bathsheba, born to them in Jerusalem.

H7731.name: Shobach
H7731.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H7731.brief: Commander of Hadadezer's army, killed by David's men.
H7731.short: Shobach (or Shophach) was the commander of Hadadezer's army, who was killed by David's men during a battle.

H7732H.name: Shobal
H7732H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7732H.brief: Son of Hur, founder of Kiriath-jearim, Judahite descendant.
H7732H.short: Shobal was a Judahite, the son of Hur and the father (ie founder) of Kiriath-jearim.

H7732G.name: Shobal
H7732G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7732G.brief: Horite chief, son of Seir, in the land of Edom.
H7732G.short: Shobal was a Horite chief, the son of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom.

H7733.name: Shobek
H7733.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7733.short: Shobek was a Levite who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow God's law.

H7719.name: Shoham
H7719.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7719.brief: Merarite Levite of the family of Jaaziah.
H7719.short: Shoham was a Merarite Levite belonging to the family of Jaaziah during the organization of the Levitical service.

H7763H.name: Shomer
H7763H.short: Shomer (or Shemer) was an Asherite descendant, the son of Heber.

H7763G.name: Shomer
H7763G.desc: Moabite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7763G.brief: Moabite mother of an assassin of King Joash.
H7763G.short: Shomer (or Shimrith) was a Moabite woman, the mother of Jozabad (or Zabad), who was one of the assassins of King Joash of Judah.

H7774.name: Shua
H7774.short: Shua was an Asherite descendant, the daughter of Heber.

H7770.name: Shua
H7770.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7770.brief: Father of Canaanite wife of Judah, mother of Er, Onan, and Shelah.
H7770.short: Shua was the father of a Canaanite woman, the wife of Judah, and the mother of Er, Onan, and Shelah.

H7744.name: Shuah
H7744.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7744.brief: Son of Abraham and Keturah, ancestor of a tribe.
H7744.short: Shuah was a son of Abraham and Keturah, and his descendants formed a tribe.

H7777B.name: Shual
H7777B.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7777B.short: Shual (or Ulla) was an Asherite descendant, the son of Zophah.

H7746.name: Shuhah
H7746.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7746.brief: Brother of Chelub, descendant of Judah.
H7746.short: Shuhah was the brother of Chelub and a descendant of Judah.

H7747.name: Shuhites
H7747.brief: People group associated with Bildad, Job's friend.
H7747.short: The Shuhites were a people group to which Bildad, one of Job's friends, belonged.

H7759.name: Shulammites
H7759.brief: A group or place mentioned in Song of Solomon.
H7759.short: The Shulammites are mentioned in the Song of Solomon, possibly referring to a group of people or a place associated with the Shulammite woman.

H7767.name: Shunammites
H7767.brief: People from Shunem; includes Abishag and the Shunammite woman
H7767.short: Shunammites, inhabitants of Shunem, including Abishag, David's nurse, and the Shunammite woman, Elisha's benefactor.

H7764.name: Shuni
H7764.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7764.brief: Son of Gad, ancestor of the Shunite clan.
H7764.short: Shuni was a son of Gad and the ancestor of the Shunite clan within the tribe of Gad.

H7755I.name: Soco
H7755I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7755I.brief: Son of Heber, from the tribe of Judah.
H7755I.short: Soco was a son of Heber, from the tribe of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H7740.name: Shaveh
H7740.brief: Valley where Chedorlaomer defeated the Emites
H7740.short: Shaveh Kiriathaim was a valley where Chedorlaomer and his allies defeated the Emites before battling the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah (<ref="Gen. 14:5, 17">Gen. 14:5, 17</ref>).

H7772.name: Shoa
H7772.brief: People group mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
H7772.short: Shoa was a people group mentioned along with the Babylonians, Chaldeans, and Assyrians in Ezekiel's prophecy against Jerusalem (<ref="Ezek. 23:23">Ezek. 23:23</ref>).

H7777A.name: Shual
H7777A.brief: Region raided by Philistines during Saul's reign
H7777A.short: Shual was a region raided by Philistine raiders during Saul's reign, along with Ophrah and the land of Shaalim (<ref="1Sam. 13:17">1Sam. 13:17</ref>).

H7766.name: Shunem
H7766.brief: Town in Issachar; home of the Shunammite woman
H7766.short: Shunem was a town allotted to the tribe of Issachar (<ref="Josh. 19:18">Josh. 19:18</ref>), known for being the home of the Shunammite woman who hosted Elisha (<ref="2Ki. 4:8">2Ki. 4:8</ref>) and where the Philistines camped before battling Saul (<ref="1Sam. 28:4">1Sam. 28:4</ref>).

H7793.name: Shur
H7793.brief: Wilderness area between Canaan and Egypt
H7793.short: Shur was a wilderness area between Canaan and Egypt, mentioned in connection with Hagar (<ref="Gen. 16:7">Gen. 16:7</ref>), Abraham (<ref="Gen. 20:1; 25:18">Gen. 20:1; 25:18</ref>), the Israelites' wanderings (<ref="Exod. 15:22">Exod. 15:22</ref>), and Saul's battles (<ref="1Sam. 15:7; 27:8">1Sam. 15:7; 27:8</ref>).

H7708.name: Siddim Valley
H7708.brief: Valley near the Dead Sea; site of battle
H7708.short: The Valley of Siddim, located near the Dead Sea, was the site of a battle between the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah and the kings of Elam and their allies (<ref="Gen. 14:3, 8, 10">Gen. 14:3, 8, 10</ref>).

H7755G.name: Socoh
H7755G.brief: Town in Judah; site of David's battle with Goliath
H7755G.short: Socoh was a town in the Shephelah region of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:35">Josh. 15:35</ref>), known for being near the site of David's battle with Goliath (<ref="1Sam. 17:1">1Sam. 17:1</ref>) and later fortified by Rehoboam (<ref="2Chr. 11:7">2Chr. 11:7</ref>).

H7755H.name: Socoh
H7755H.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah
H7755H.short: Socoh, a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the hill country (<ref="Jos. 15:48">Jos. 15:48</ref>).

H7796.name: Sorek Valley
H7796.brief: Valley where Delilah lived, Samson's downfall occurred
H7796.short: Sorek Valley, the place where Delilah lived and where Samson's downfall began (<ref="Judg. 16:4">Judg. 16:4</ref>).

H7756.name: Sucathite
H7756.brief: A Kenite clan skilled in scribal arts
H7756.short: The Sucathites were a Kenite clan known for their scribal skills, mentioned in <ref="1Ch.2.55">1Ch.2.55</ref> among the descendants of Salma.
